rv.q: I can't remember when I saw a play that was so utterly clear yet had such a startling destination.
There’s a frazzled lunacy to David Ireland ‘s black comedy.

cn.t: Ireland's bone-shaking play combines horror, humor, and thought in a taut production that leaves audiences shell-shocked. Critics praise its clarity and unsettling examination of a hardwired Ulster loyalist lost in a changing Northern Ireland.
